methods.name: FastSurfer
methods.objective: FastSurfer T1 segmentation and cortical surface reconstruction. Preserve distinctions between segmentation-only, surface-only, optional modules, and FreeSurfer licence requirements.

methods.name: FreeSurfer mri_glmfit group analysis
methods.objective: Surface-based group GLM using the official GroupAnalysis tutorial and mri_glmfit reference. Cover subject order, common-surface resampling, required data/design/contrast files, optional settings, masking and interpretation.

methods.name: Connectome Workbench vertex areas and metric statistics
methods.objective: Document wb_command -surface-vertex-areas and -metric-stats, including input/output, units, reduction/percentile choice, optional ROI and map matching. The requested shorthand -surface-area is not the documented command; do not invent it.

methods.name: AFNI NMT v2 and CHARM
methods.objective: Use of the macaque NMT v2 reference template and CHARM hierarchical atlas. Distinguish bundled resources from subject data, spatial variants/voxel sizes, six atlas levels and zero-based selectors. The installer currently defaults to v2.1: retain version scopes.

selection: all verified items in the same four fields as development; exclude exact normalized quote or statement duplicates against development; no outcome-based selection
